# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: multitier-app
description: Production-grade multi-tier application Helm chart
type: application
version: 1.0.0
appVersion: "1.0.0"
---
# FILE: values.yaml
replicaCount: 3
imagePullSecrets: []
frontend:
  image:
    repository: nginx
    tag: "1.25-alpine"
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  containerPort: 80
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 128Mi
    limits:
      cpu: 500m
      memory: 512Mi
backend:
  image:
    repository: your-backend-image
    tag: "1.0.0"
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  containerPort: 8080
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 200m
      memory: 256Mi
    limits:
      cpu: 1000m
      memory: 1Gi
postgres:
  image:
    repository: postgres
    tag: "15-alpine"
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  containerPort: 5432
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 250m
      memory: 512Mi
    limits:
      cpu: 1000m
      memory: 2Gi
  storageSize: 10Gi
  storageClassName: ""
secrets:
  dbUser: postgres
  dbPassword: change-me-in-production
  dbName: appdb
service:
  frontend:
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 80
  backend:
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 8080
  postgres:
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 5432
securityContext:
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 1000
  fsGroup: 1000
  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
---
# FILE: templates/_helpers.tpl
{{- define "multitier-app.labels" -}}
helm.sh/chart: {{ include "multitier-app.chart" . }}
app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .Release.Service }}
app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
{{- end -}}
{{- define "multitier-app.selectorLabels" -}}
app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
{{- end -}}
{{- define "multitier-app.chart" -}}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Chart.Name .Chart.Version | replace "+" "_" | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" -}}
{{- end -}}
---
# FILE: templates/configmap-frontend.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-frontend-config
  labels:
    {{- include "multitier-app.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    tier: frontend
data:
  nginx.conf: |
    server {
      listen 80;
      location / { root /usr/share/nginx/html; }
    }
---
# FILE: templates/configmap-backend.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-backend-config
  labels:
    {{- include "multitier-app.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    tier: backend
data:
  app.properties: |
    server.port=8080
    spring.datasource.url=jdbc:postgresql://{{ .Release.Name }}-postgres:5432/{{ .Values.secrets.dbName }}
---
# FILE: templates/configmap-postgres.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-postgres-config
  labels:
    {{- include "multitier-app.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    tier: postgres
data:
  postgresql.conf: |
    listen_addresses = '*'
---
# FILE: templates/secret.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-db-secret
  labels:
    {{- include "multitier-app.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
type: Opaque
stringData:
  username: {{ .Values.secrets.dbUser }}
  password: {{ .Values.secrets.dbPassword }}
  dbname: {{ .Values.secrets.dbName }}
---
# FILE: templates/deployment-frontend.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-frontend
  labels:
    {{- include "multitier-app.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    tier: frontend
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "multitier-app.selectorLabels" . | nindent 6 }}
      tier: frontend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "multitier-app.selectorLabels" . | nindent 8 }}
        tier: frontend
    spec:
      securityContext:
        {{- toYaml .Values.securityContext | nindent 8 }}
      containers:
        - name: frontend
          image: "{{ .Values.frontend.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.frontend.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.frontend.image.pullPolicy }}
          ports:
            - containerPort: {{ .Values.frontend.containerPort }}
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.frontend.resources | nindent 12 }}
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config
              mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d
              readOnly: true
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 101
      volumes:
        - name: config
          configMap:
            name: {{ .Release.Name }}-frontend-config
---
# FILE: templates/deployment-backend.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-backend
  labels:
    {{- include "multitier-app.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    tier: backend
spec:

        - name: config

---
# FILE: templates/statefulset-postgres.yaml

spec:
  serviceName: {{ .Release.Name }}-postgres
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "multitier-app.selectorLabels" . | nindent 6 }}
      tier: postgres
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "multitier-app.selectorLabels" . | nindent 8 }}
        tier: postgres
    spec:
      securityContext:
        {{- toYaml .Values.securityContext | nindent 8 }}
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: "{{ .Values.postgres.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.postgres.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.postgres.image.pullPolicy }}
          ports:
            - containerPort: {{ .Values.postgres.containerPort }}
          env:
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-db-secret
                  key: username
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-db-secret
                  key: password
            - name: POSTGRES_DB
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-db-secret
                  key: dbname
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.postgres.resources | nindent 12 }}
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
            - name: config
              mountPath: /etc/postgresql
              readOnly: true
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 999
      volumes:
        - name: config
          configMap:
            name: {{
